name: Deadly Quiet
body:
School illusion; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S

EFFECT

Range creature touched
Duration 1 hour/ level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

With a touch, the knowledge of scouts and assassins flows into your target.

When you cast this spell you impart the target with increased subtlety, allowing them to use your ranks in Stealth in place of their own. The target also ignores an amount of armor check penalty to Stealth checks equal to your caster level.
